papers.citation: Robert Petrunia, Leonard Sabetti and Marcel Voia (January 2019 update; September 2018 original), Tail Risk in the Automated Clearing Settlement System (ACSS), Payments Canada Discussion Paper 7.
papers.actual_reading_scope: Partial body: PDF/printed pp. 8–15, especially §§2,3(a–d),4,4b; cover/summary checked.

target.evidence: Daily cross-participant maximum end-of-day net debit; collateral return levels, not a single dealer’s future absolute path maximum.

data_unit.evidence: ACSS direct-clearer settlement balances; January 2002–March 2017 payment sample.

known_floor.evidence: GEV/GPD support and threshold excesses; origin-specific |N₀| projection n.r. in read methods.

mature_labels.evidence: 2002–2006 initializes January 2007; monthly incoming-data updates. Overlapping forward-peak label embargo n.r.

evaluation.evidence: Distribution/quantile fit, threshold/block sensitivity and evolving model versus empirical collateral shortfalls; not simply static fitting.

cross_source_transfer.evidence: Participant-specific ACSS models and heterogeneity; independent-source transfer n.r. in read application.

papers.citation: Neville Arjani, Fuchun Li and Leonard Sabetti (2020), Monitoring Intraday Liquidity Risks in a Real Time Gross Settlement System, Payments Canada.
papers.actual_reading_scope: Partial body: PDF pp.9–15,19–22 (printed pp.7–13,17–20); §3.1, §3.2, §3.3. Publication day n.r.; 2020 independently corroborated by Payments Canada.

target.evidence: Remaining-day payment-demand/source liquidity ratio; risk event when ratio exceeds one.

data_unit.evidence: Timestamped LVTS Tranche-1 incoming/outgoing payments and collateral limits; five participants emphasized.

known_floor.evidence: Uses known cumulative flows and credit limits, subtracting observed flows from predicted daily totals; |N₀| floor projection n.r.

mature_labels.evidence: Train through November 2017; evaluate December 2017. Specific overlapping-path label embargo n.r.

evaluation.evidence: SUR, ARIMA and diffusion payment forecasts compared by RMSE; observed/predicted LRI and confidence bands.

cross_source_transfer.evidence: Multiple participants within LVTS; independent-source transfer n.r. in read sections.

papers.citation: Robert F. Engle and Simone Manganelli (2004), CAViaR: Conditional Autoregressive Value at Risk by Regression Quantiles, JBES 22(4),367–381, DOI 10.1198/073500104000000370.
papers.actual_reading_scope: Partial formal body: printed pp.367–371,373–375, including §§3–6 and Appendix A; Table1 header/results text inspected, not every appendix proof.

target.evidence: Dynamic conditional return quantile / one-day VaR; not sampled future position maximum.

data_unit.evidence: Daily GM, IBM and S&P500 returns, Datastream, 1986–1999.

known_floor.evidence: Recursive return quantiles; |N₀|-constrained peak-report construction n.r.

mature_labels.evidence: Lagged observables; first 2,892 returns estimate, last 500 test. DQ asymptotics require growing estimation/evaluation samples and vanishing ratio.

evaluation.evidence: Reports regression-quantile objective, exception proportions and in/out-of-sample DQ tests together; hit counts alone explicitly insufficient.

cross_source_transfer.evidence: Three return series; not a compatible unseen-dealer position-peak validation.

papers.citation: Werner Ehm, Tilmann Gneiting, Alexander Jordan and Fabian Krüger (2016), Of quantiles and expectiles: consistent scoring functions, Choquet representations and forecast rankings, JRSSB 78(3),505–562; DOI 10.1111/rssb.12154.
papers.actual_reading_scope: Partial author preprint v2 (arXiv revision 17 April 2015; PDF title date20 April): §§3.2–3.4,4.1–4.3,5, PDF pp.15–20,22–26. Formal2016 metadata checked via Wiley/KIT, not formal full text.

target.evidence: Quantile/expectile consistent-score dominance; Murphy diagrams and finite empirical threshold checks.

data_unit.evidence: Inflation survey means, recession probabilities and hourly wind-speed quantiles.

known_floor.evidence: Nonnegative wind support supplies zero-left-end one-sided intervals; moving |N₀| report floor n.r.

mature_labels.evidence: Two-hour-ahead wind cases reuse original estimation/evaluation; forward-path label embargo n.r.

evaluation.evidence: Coverage, sharpness and Murphy ranking are considered together. Intersections preclude score-class dominance; this principle is established prior work.

cross_source_transfer.evidence: Multiple illustrative domains; no claim of compatible unseen-dealer position-peak validation.

papers.citation: Darrell Duffie, Michael Fleming, Frank Keane, Claire Nelson, Or Shachar and Peter Van Tassel (August2023; revised October2023), Dealer Capacity and U.S. Treasury Market Functionality, NYFed Staff Report1070; DOI10.59576/sr.1070.
papers.actual_reading_scope: Partial body: introduction PDF pp.2–11; §6 PDF pp.26–29; Appendix E PDF pp.60–61. Not entire70-page report.

target.evidence: Treasury illiquidity conditional on volatility/capacity; AppendixE separately forecasts dealer PnL VaR.

data_unit.evidence: BrokerTec, TRACE, dealer-level FR2004 positions and BHC/desk PnL/VaR; not public aggregate alone.

known_floor.evidence: Utilization normalizes current dealer measures by full-sample maximum; origin-specific peak-report floor n.r.

mature_labels.evidence: Lagged predictors and daily expanding-window VaR with one-year burn-in. Overlapping future-position-max label embargo n.r.

evaluation.evidence: Quantile pseudo-R², bootstrapped uncertainty and expanding-window out-of-sample PnL quantile comparisons.

cross_source_transfer.evidence: Distinct data sources and dealers, measuring capacity/illiquidity; not validation of this paper’s FX-to-public-aggregate peak-forecast transfer.
